title: {name}'s partner is due this week
{first} could become a dad on game day
text: The baby's due on game day and we play away. He'll do whatever you ask, but you can see where his head is.

choices.label: Tell him to be there

effects.why: You told him to be there for the birth

choices.result: {first} is there for the birth. He won't forget it.

choices.label: Ask him to play, then fly home

effects.why: You asked him to play the week his first child was born

choices.result: {first} plays. He's on the first flight home after the siren.

title: {name}'s dad is in hospital
text: He's from interstate and wants to fly home this week.

choices.label: Put him on the plane

effects.why: You put him on a plane when his dad was in hospital

choices.result: {first} flies home. The club looks after the flights.

choices.label: Ask him to play first

effects.why: You asked him to play while his dad was in hospital

choices.result: {first} stays and plays. His head's somewhere else.

title: {first}'s brother is getting married on game day
text: He's the best man. The wedding's been booked for a year.

effects.why: You let him be best man at his brother's wedding

choices.label: He plays

effects.why: You kept him from his brother's wedding

choices.result: {first} plays. He watches the speeches on his phone.

title: {name}'s partner has a job offer back home
text: He's out of contract at season's end, and home is calling.

choices.label: Tell him the club will help

effects.why: You told him the club would help his family settle

choices.result: The club starts looking for work for his partner here.

effects.why: You told him footy came before his family's plans

title: {name} isn't sleeping
text: A newborn at home and three hours' sleep a night. The fitness staff have noticed.

effects.why: You eased off when the baby wasn't sleeping

choices.label: Business as usual
choices.result: {first} trains as normal, on not much sleep.

title: {name}'s partner graduates on Thursday
text: It's right in the middle of main training.

effects.why: You gave him the afternoon for his partner's graduation
You kept him at training for his partner's graduation

title: {name} settles on his first house on Thursday
text: He needs the morning off to sign everything.

effects.why: You gave him the morning to buy his first house

choices.label: Do it after training
choices.result: {first} signs after training, a bit flat about it.
